scientific_integrity: All quantified claims are proved in the accompanying proof; the included checker is finite symbolic corroboration and does not constitute independent audit.
scientific_limitations: The sharp bound and equality statement cover only the five-character coordinate cross on the continuous two-torus at sixth power, with Haar probability measure. Wider frequency supports and noise/perturbation bounds are unproved; a historical-priority risk remains.
title: Sharp sixth Fourier moment for the five-point toral cross
